plain: The share of private facts that an assistant leaked at least once across many tasks and tries.
eli5: How many of your secrets got told to the wrong person even once, if you ask lots of times.
technical: CIMemories' privacy metric (Definition 3.1): for each attribute that should be withheld in at least one task, check whether it was revealed in any such task across n sampled responses per task, and report the share revealed; a per-attribute worst case that can only rise with more tasks or samples.
